metadata.title: Fabrinet jumps on strong data center demand, and other early market movers - MarketWatch

content.text:
Nov. 3, 5:02am ET
Fabrinet jumps on strong data center demand, and other early market movers
Here are some of stocks making notable moves in Tuesday's premarket action:
Fabrinet shares are jumping 10% after the supplier of components for data centers delivered better-than-expected results and the CEO said “there looks to be no end in sight to the demand from the customers.”
Apple shares are down more than 4% despite the iPhone-maker reporting revenue and earnings well above analysts' forecasts. With the stock trading on a multiple above 35, investors chose to focus on higher costs for memory chips and slowing services growth.
Palantir Technologies shares are slipping 6% as a "bombastic" quarter for earnings could not support a stock that one analyst described as "priced to perfection."
Shares of Lattice Semiconductor are jumping 9% after the company reported a surge in revenue, gave upbeat guidance, and Baird raised its price target to $195 from $174 citing accelerated AI-linked momentum.
